observation.trust_scope: externally assumed physical roots and source-group budget; untrusted nominal centres are metadata

current_basis.scope: continuous feasible-world outer cover; explicit external trust roots and q/r assumptions

decision.scope: diagnosis requires positive certificate or exact witness; no zero-lower impossibility claim

frontier.scope: exact finite bundle cost minimum for this sufficient common-model pre-gate and declared finite forecasts; not a continuous optimal trust theorem
